edges.reason: _msgSender returns msg.sender, the untrusted caller.
block.timestamp is consumed by randomly() as its only seed.
Miner-controllable timestamp feeds the weak randomness operation.
transfer sends as _msgSender().
approve sets the owner to _msgSender().
transferFrom reads the allowance of _msgSender().
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the value movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
randomly() writes the draw into DoTheCity.
randomly() performs the weak randomness operation.
_CityCasino triggers randomly(400) to decide whether to burn.
_approve calls randomly(16000) when ApproveTheCity is set.
_transfer invokes _frontrunnerProtection before moving value.
_transfer invokes _CityCasino which mutates other holders' state.
_transfer rewrites _balances for sender and recipient.
_CityCasino executes the arbitrary holder balance burn.
Burn loop divides the _balances entries of recorded holders.
_approve executes the balance division side effect.
Division writes back into the approver's _balances entry.
_frontrunnerProtection reaches an unconditional require(false) for non-whitelisted senders.
DeployCCC increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
DeployCCC credits the recipient's _balances entry.
DeployCCC sets PDContract to the new total supply.
DeployCCC computes CitadelTax = totalSupply / 20.
DeployCCC computes ArmyCapital = CitadelTax * 1.
ERC20Token constructor mints via DeployCCC.
CitadelCityCapital constructor invokes the ERC20Token constructor.
_transfer appends the recipient to citadelArray on every transfer.
_burn subtracts from the account balance and credits address(0).
_approve writes the spender allowance.
_transfer clears HelloFRs when the creator moves funds.
_transfer latches BigCityCapital true for creator-initiated moves.
_transfer may read/rewrite the BigChainContract toggle.
_transfer may reset PDContract to CitadelTax.
_transfer can whitelist the recipient in CitadelContract.

recipient parameter flows into the internal transfer.

subtractedValue is checked and removed from the allowance.

vl parameter bounds the pseudo-random modulus.
creator_ parameter seeds _creator during construction.
initialSupply is passed to DeployCCC as the mint amount.
sender parameter decides whitelist exemption in _frontrunnerProtection.
amount parameter is compared against ArmyCapital and PDContract.
sender parameter gates the casino trigger condition.
owner parameter indexes the allowance and balance ledgers.
amount parameter is stored as the new allowance.
account parameter is the balance subtracted in _burn.
amount parameter is the burned quantity.
sender parameter is the debited account of transferFrom.
recipient parameter receives the transferred value.
amount parameter is bounded by the sender allowance.
creator argument forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
initialSupply argument forwarded to DeployCCC.
senderBalance caches _balances[sender] before the write-back.
currentAllowance caches the allowance consumed by transferFrom.
temp1 (20) is the divisor producing CitadelTax.
temp2 (1) is the multiplier producing ArmyCapital.
msgSender local is written into the Ownable _owner slot.
Loop index walks citadelArray to burn holder balances.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount argument only exists to feed the internal transfer.
The recipient argument only exists to feed the internal transfer.
The sender argument only indexes the balance ledger inside _transfer.
The spender argument is consumed by the approval entry point.
addedValue is only used to raise the allowance.
subtractedValue is only used to lower the allowance.
The mint account is only read by the mint routine.
vl is only the modulus of the pseudo-random draw.
The creator argument is consumed during token initialization alongside minting.
initialSupply becomes the minted amount passed to DeployCCC.
The sender argument is only used by the whitelist gate.
The amount argument is only compared against the transfer caps.
The sender argument only gates the casino trigger.
The owner argument only indexes allowance and balance storage.
The amount argument is only stored as the allowance.
The account argument is only the burn subject.
The amount argument is only the burned quantity.
The sender argument only identifies the debited account and allowance key.
The recipient argument only identifies the credited account.
The amount argument only bounds the allowance consumption.
The creator argument is only forwarded to the parent constructor and mint.
The initialSupply argument is only forwarded to DeployCCC.
Cached sender balance is a pure intermediate of the transfer.
Cached allowance is a pure intermediate of transferFrom.
temp1 is an in-function constant divisor for CitadelTax.
temp2 is an in-function constant multiplier for ArmyCapital.
The cached deployer address is just the _msgSender() result.
The loop index exists only to iterate citadelArray during the casino burn.
